resource: Wheel reset receipts of one Character per reset revision
unit: receipts per Character per reset revision
allocation_impact: A reset writes 1 CharacterRevision and 1 RULESET_RESET receipt, 0 items and 0 value lines, once per Character per reset revision; its occurrence is derived from the Character and both revisions, so a replay writes nothing.
boundary_tests: max=1: the admission reset commits once
max+1: a second admission finds the stored revision active and writes nothing
notes: WHEEL-0 §8 row 'Wheel reset (WHEEL0-RST-1)' (unnumbered in the decision); test: character_wheel_postgres_cases::the_admission_reset_clears_a_stale_allocation_once. Registered by WHEEL-W1.
